name: CBT-i Coach
one_liner: Free VA app for CBT for insomnia: sleep diary, sleep-scheduling tools and relaxation audio, best used with a clinician.
best_for: People doing CBT for insomnia (CBT-I) with a clinician who want a sleep diary and tools
Veterans and others with insomnia who want a free, no-account CBT-I toolkit
People who want to learn sleep habits and relaxation techniques without ads
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 (veterans press 1)
People with possible sleep apnea or another sleep disorder who haven't been assessed
People who want a fully guided self-help course: the VA's separate Insomnia Coach app is built for that
short_description: A free VA app with a sleep diary, sleep-scheduling tools, education and relaxation audio based on CBT for insomnia.
long_description: CBT-i Coach was created by the VA, Stanford School of Medicine and the Department of Defense for people taking part in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia with a health provider, though anyone can use it. It includes a sleep diary, a tool to work out a sleep schedule (sleep restriction and stimulus control), sleep education, reminders and relaxation audio. It is free, has no ads and needs no account; what you enter stays on your phone. A small pilot randomized trial found it was feasible to add to clinician-led CBT-I, and an 18-month study of public users found improvements in insomnia symptoms. CBT-I itself is the first-line treatment for chronic insomnia.
patient_summary: CBT-i Coach gives you a sleep diary, help setting a sleep schedule, sleep education and relaxation exercises, based on CBT for insomnia. It is free from the VA, needs no account, and your entries stay on your phone. It works best alongside a clinician who is treating your insomnia.

pricing.notes: Free from the VA, with no in-app purchases or ads.

privacy.notes: VA apps send no identifying data to VA or third parties; entries stay on your device (anonymous usage data is collected). HIPAA applies only if you share data with a provider.

seo.title: CBT-i Coach: Free Insomnia App from VA | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: CBT-i Coach is a free app for insomnia. Uses evidence-based CBT-i techniques. Developed by the VA. iOS & Android.

faqs.a: Yes, CBT-i Coach is completely free with no in-app purchases, subscriptions, or hidden costs. It was developed by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs as a public health resource.

faqs.q: Can I use CBT-i Coach without a therapist?
faqs.a: Yes. While CBT-i Coach was designed to supplement therapy, many people use it as a standalone self-help tool. The app includes educational content and guided exercises that can be used independently.

faqs.q: How long does it take for CBT-i Coach to work?
faqs.a: Most people see improvements within 2-4 weeks of consistent use. CBT-i typically takes 4-8 weeks for full effect. The key is following the program consistently, including keeping sleep diaries and implementing the behavioral strategies.

faqs.q: Is CBT-i Coach only for veterans?
faqs.a: No. While developed by the VA, CBT-i Coach is available to anyone. The app is free for all civilians and veterans alike.
